# Sani Building Corp

> Sani Building Corp is a Brooklyn-based renovation and repair contractor serving all five NYC boroughs and Long Island since 2015. We handle both residential and commercial projects — bathroom renovations, painting, flooring, carpentry, water damage restoration, and same-day handyman services — for homeowners, restaurants, retail stores, and offices. Rated 4.9 stars across 62 Google reviews.

## Contact
- Phone: (332) 277-0990
- Email: contact@sanibuildingcorp.com
- Address: 2954 Brighton 12th Street, Brooklyn, NY 11235
- Service area: Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, and Long Island (Nassau & Suffolk County)

## Services
- [Bathroom Renovation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-renovation): Full bathroom renovation and remodeling for homes and businesses.
- [Bathroom Refresh — Wall Panels](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-wall-panels): No-demolition bathroom updates with waterproof wall panels.
- [Bathroom Floor Tile Installation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-floor-tile-installation): Tile installation for bathroom floors.
- [Painting](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/painting): Interior and exterior painting for homes and commercial spaces.
- [Flooring](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/flooring): Hardwood, tile, and LVP flooring installation.
- [Carpentry & Millwork](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/carpentry): Custom carpentry, stairs, decks, and trim.
- [Water Damage Restoration](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/water-damage): Ceiling, roof leak, wall, and floor water damage repair with insurance support.
- [Handyman Services](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/handyman): Same-day repairs and maintenance for homes, restaurants, retail, and offices.
